setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 loops 8 steps at 90 BPM on the test device and is set to Foundation. Pattern 1 (C, D, E, F on steps 1 to 4, velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) is the Anchor; pattern 2 (a C at velocity 100) has trigs on steps 3 and 7, so step 3 is a step both patterns trig. Both patterns are assigned. The norns shows the Rhythm page and the grid lights steps 1 to 4 and 7.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press Channel (3,8), turn E1 to Channel tasks, E2 to Merge modes and press K3. Strategy reads FOUNDATION: Foundation, not the saved trig merge, is choosing this channel's trigs.
steps.title: Open Merge modes

steps.caption: Turn E3 left to SKIP. The footer reads SKIP APPLIED and the Strategy key (14,8) dims. Skip applies a trig only if it appears in exactly one selected pattern, so step 3, where both patterns trig, will not sound.
steps.title: Hand the trigs back to Skip

steps.caption: Tap Play, let two loops run, then tap Stop. The strip below lists C D F (60, 62, 65) from pattern 1 on steps 1, 2 and 4, then a C at velocity 100 on step 7, which only pattern 2 trigs. Step 3 is silent: there is no E and no merged note.
steps.title: Hear Skip

steps.caption: Reopen Merge modes, select Strategy and turn E3 to ALL. Strategy and Active read ALL. All applies a trig if it appears in any selected pattern, so step 3 now sounds.
steps.title: Switch the Strategy to All

steps.caption: Tap Play, let two loops run, then tap Stop. Step 3 now sounds, merged from both patterns: the Average note merge puts the E (degree III) and the C (degree I) on degree II, a D (62), and the Average velocity merge turns 107 and 100 into 104. Look for D at velocity 104 between 62 and 65 in the strip below; step 7 is still a C at velocity 100.
steps.title: Hear All

title: Skip and All on a step both patterns trig
